Creature combat frames

Combat animation samples: every registered creature has five transparent action rows. Cells render at the battle portrait width with a shared bottom-center anchor.

Open the normal game preview to see attack, recoil, faint and capture event timing in battle. The full roster contact sheet is at art/characters/reviews/creature-combat-contact-sheet.png. Source artwork and export metadata are retained in the repository.
